browser: installed Google Chrome, standalone persistent profile
decision: Reject a bundled settings promotion from this comparison. The reversed baseline is faster than both candidates, and every image acceptance leg fails. The matching sampled controller/gameplay digests do not remove strong time-order and JIT-coverage drift.
limits: Scripted native-frame controller input is not human play. Sampled rolling fingerprints are not full machine equivalence. The experimental binary has a prebuilt cache but source metadata different from the retained patch. No other stage, browser or device is certified.
